BUILDPLAN.md T-15b (M3).

The verifier in code: inherit `verify.py`'s procedure after audit; **add Miri** (strict provenance, Tree Borrows for UB-intended), the flag set, target triple, the §3.2 record, **the pin comparison and stale rejection, and the `Runner` seam with its stub and recorded fixtures** (`SPEC.md` §7.2, D-17, D-18); `verify <program>`

Criteria: AC-6–11, AC-13, AC-87, G-2
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-14, T-15a
BUILDPLAN notes: Audit ticket for `verify.py`. Serialized on `pyproject.toml` with T-16, T-17

Orchestrator notes: `mvp/tools/verify.py` never calls Miri (confirmed by grep); this ticket adds it. The pin is read from T-15a's definition, never re-declared. Audit ticket: read `verify.py` before inheriting.

Workflow mode: sub-agent-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: ORCHESTRATOR: read PQ-19's DONE comment (lattice comments PQ-19) before planning. Its notes for T-15b are binding: read_pin() is the only pin reader; RealRunner calls sandbox.run_in_sandbox rather than adding a second shell-out exemption; use sandbox.RunnerTimeout, never import subprocess; MIRI_SYSROOT is set in the image; the run mode compiles fresh per container so N runs are N containers; T-15a records no target_triple, you do. The miri mode in pipeline/src/popquiz/sandbox.py is minimal (no strict provenance, no Tree Borrows): that file is CLEARED for this ticket for the Miri flag set and a config parameter only (MIRIFLAGS per config); nothing else in it, and not the Dockerfile or pin.toml.
READY PQ-20 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/verifier HEAD ff99bd27914293e2738de33a193f26d525041ea2 BASE ff99bd27914293e2738de33a193f26d525041ea2 MODE active

QUESTION PQ-20 (non-blocking; I proceed on the fallback unless you answer by implementation):
1. sandbox.py clearance. verify must read the image's rustc -Vv and cargo miri --version before running anything (D-17). sandbox.MODES has no mode that does that, and my clearance there is MIRIFLAGS only. Ask: clear one more mode, 'toolchain', whose script is 'rustc -Vv' then 'cargo +nightly-<pin> miri --version' (same docker argv, same limits, no -e, no mount). Fallback if not cleared: RealRunner asks through the existing 'run' mode, compiling a fixed probe program that spawns rustc -Vv and cargo miri --version inside the container. Both are real machine output; the mode is plainer to read.
2. justfile PENDING. Once 'just verify' is a real recipe, PENDING's 'verify:T-15b' entry makes test-full print verify as not built, which is false. That entry sits on the same line PQ-24 edits for bank-audit, so I will not touch it: I leave it and flag it in DONE for you to drop after PQ-24 lands, unless you clear me to remove that one token.

ORCHESTRATOR: PR #13 (bank audit) merged to main at d88fab4. main now carries popquiz/audit.py, popquiz/slot.py and the bank-audit justfile recipe. When you next touch git: git fetch origin && git merge origin/main (merge, never rebase, per your brief). #12 is still open; keep the 'based on #12' line.

ORCHESTRATOR: your parent PR #12 (sandbox image) merged to main at 696b3ce, and #11 (burst spike) at 77c4a32; the branch ai-c11-cc/sandbox-image was auto-deleted on the remote. Your local branch tracks it, so run: git fetch origin --prune && git branch --unset-upstream && git merge origin/main (merge, never rebase, per your brief; it should be a no-op or trivial since your first commit merged main already). Your PR diff against main is now clean; drop the 'Based on #12' line and open against main as planned. Push with git push -u origin ai-c11-cc/verifier when you get there.

PAUSED PQ-20 at the client's word (clean close-out mid-plan; planning resumes next session). Status stays in_planning. Branch ai-c11-cc/verifier HEAD 9a758cdb5463585d7e290aaaac48d77961dee69c = signed merge of origin/main 238146e onto ff99bd2; not pushed; nothing implemented. Draft plan (planner subagent output + delegator triage, NOT yet plan-reviewed) is in the plan file. Still open: my two questions above (toolchain mode; PENDING line). New for you, found while planning: bank.correct_index derives only output and does-not-compile answers, so an accepted UB or panic question gets None, or a distractor if its text equals stdout. That is a §3.1 gap on T-14's module; I will not fix it here, and verify's provenance check will fail closed on those records.

ORCHESTRATOR (resume, 2026-09-25): the fleet is back. Your old tab is gone; a fresh session resumes you in the same worktree from .claude/resume-prompt.md. Rulings on your open points: (1) toolchain mode: CLEARED. Add a 'toolchain' mode to sandbox.MODES whose script is 'rustc -Vv' then 'cargo +nightly-<pin date> miri --version', same docker argv, same limits, no -e, no mount; tests on the fake docker callable like the other modes. (3) bank.correct_index gap: recorded as contract finding F-19 and routed upstream. Run ruling, CLEARED to you as a minimal change with tests: when the record ran and the machine observed a panic (non-zero exit_code) the correct option is the single option of kind 'panic'; when Miri flagged UB and both borrow models agreed the correct option is the single option of kind 'ub'; both by option kind, never by text equality, and two matches still raise BankError. Say so under deviations. (4) Your parent PR #12 merged at 696b3ce; main is 696b3ce. First act after the guards: git fetch origin --prune && git branch --unset-upstream && git merge origin/main (dry-run from here: clean). Then open the PR against main with no 'Based on' line.
